definition: BigDL is a distributed deep learning framework for Apache Spark, created by Jason Dai at Intel.
details: BigDL has its source code hosted on GitHub.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is BigDL — a small key that opens a big door.
